skill.name: context-resume
skill.description: Resume saved task context by listing session files, loading a selected session, updating progress, and removing completed sessions.
skill.summary: Resume saved Claude Code task sessions and keep progress files current.
skill.author: Claudate

security_audit.summary: All static external-command findings are false positives caused by Markdown code fences or inline labels. The skill has no real shell execution, but it does direct the agent to trust session-file content and delete session files when work is complete.

remediation.issue: Session file content can influence later agent actions.
remediation.suggestion: Tell the agent to treat session files as untrusted notes, summarize them first, and ask before following sensitive instructions.

remediation.issue: Completed session files are deleted immediately.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before deletion, or move completed files to an archive directory instead.

remediation.issue: Full session content is displayed in the conversation.
remediation.suggestion: Warn users to remove secrets and private data from session files before loading them.

semantic_findings.title: Untrusted Session Content Can Steer Agent Workflow
semantic_findings.description: The skill tells the agent to read a selected session, display it, then follow the session information and next action notes. A malicious or modified session file could influence later agent behavior if treated as trusted instructions.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The workflow explicitly loads session content and uses it to guide subsequent work. The risk depends on whether session files can be modified by untrusted project content.

semantic_findings.title: Automatic Session File Deletion
semantic_findings.description: The skill instructs the agent to immediately delete the session file after all unfinished tasks are marked complete. Mistaken task state or an incorrect file selection could cause loss of local progress records.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The deletion behavior is stated directly in the completion step and workflow diagram. The intended path is scoped, but it is still a destructive local file operation.

content.value_statement: Switching AI coding windows can lose task context and progress notes. This skill lists saved sessions, loads the chosen context, and keeps progress files updated.
actual_capabilities: Lists saved Markdown session files under docs/context-sessions.
Shows an empty-state message when no sessions exist.
Loads and displays the selected session content.
Guides continuation using priority tasks and next action notes.
Updates completed, remaining, and newly discovered tasks in the session file.
Removes the session file after all tasks are complete.
limitations: Depends on existing session files created by a compatible save workflow.
Does not validate the trustworthiness of session file content.
Does not provide a built-in backup before session deletion.
Execution depends on the hosting agent and workspace permissions.

use_cases.title: Resume interrupted implementation work
use_cases.description: Load the saved task list, key files, and next action notes after opening a new AI coding window.

use_cases.title: Continue a planned handoff
use_cases.description: Review saved progress and choose the next high-priority task from a previous coding session.

use_cases.title: Maintain long-running project tasks
use_cases.description: Keep completed and remaining work synchronized while progressing through a saved project checklist.

prompt_templates.title: List saved sessions
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner prompt for finding available saved context files.
prompt_templates.prompt: List saved context sessions and ask me which one to resume.

prompt_templates.title: Load a named session
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when you already know the session file name.
prompt_templates.prompt: Load the session named [file name], show its contents, and ask which task I want next.

prompt_templates.title: Continue by priority
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when you want the agent to resume the next planned task.
prompt_templates.prompt: Resume the selected session, read the key files, and continue with the highest-priority unfinished task.

prompt_templates.title: Resume and close session
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt for full progress maintenance.
prompt_templates.prompt: Load the selected session, continue tasks by priority, update progress after each completed item, and delete it only after all tasks are done.

output_examples.output: The skill lists available session files, shows unfinished task counts, and asks which session to load.

output_examples.input: Continue the login session from yesterday.
output_examples.output: The skill loads the matching session, displays its notes, and asks which listed task should be handled next.

output_examples.input: Update progress after finishing the export bug fix.
output_examples.output: The skill moves the completed task, updates the last modified time, and keeps remaining tasks visible.

best_practices: Review session content for secrets before asking the agent to display it.
Confirm the selected session file before any progress update.
Keep session files focused on tasks, key files, and next actions.
anti_patterns: Store API keys, tokens, or private customer data in session files.
Treat session content from an untrusted repository as authoritative instructions.
Delete session files before confirming every task is complete.

faq.question: What does this skill resume?
faq.answer: It resumes saved task context from Markdown session files under docs/context-sessions.

faq.question: Does it create new sessions?
faq.answer: No. It expects session files created by a compatible save workflow.

faq.question: Can it work with Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. It is designed for Claude Code workflows and can also be described for Claude and Codex users.

faq.question: Will it run shell commands?
faq.answer: The skill documentation does not define shell commands. It describes reading, updating, and deleting session files.

faq.question: What should users check before loading a session?
faq.answer: Users should check that the session file is trusted and does not contain secrets.

faq.question: What happens when all tasks are complete?
faq.answer: The documented workflow deletes the completed session file after all unfinished tasks are resolved.
